items.text: New Orleans (Wed/Thu): DNP - C Erik McCoy (biceps), RT Taliese Fuaga (knee), OT Asim Richards (knee, out multiple weeks); OL status 'no better' Thursday. Also DNP - LB Pete Werner (hamstring), CB Martin Emerson Jr. (concussion); RB Alvin Kamara and S Justin Reid non-injury. LIMITED - WR Jordyn Tyson (chest), CB Decamerion Richardson (thigh). Tyler Shough starts.

Chicago (Wed/Thu): CB Kyler Gordon (shoulder) DNP both days, in danger of missing Sunday. DT Jeffery Simmons (knee) limited, expected available. WR Luther Burden III cleared concussion protocol (full); RB Kyle Monangai full. IR - OT Braxton Jones, TE Cole Kmet. Caleb Williams starts.
items.source: Yahoo Sports Bears Thursday injury report
